title: Preserve non-mutating skipped generated-artifact refresh decisions

phases.objective: Preserve a trusted read-only generated-artifact refresh request outcome of skipped as a successful terminal non-dispatch decision instead of converting it into a blocked writer failure.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted generated-artifact refresh request evaluator and workflow-run dispatcher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A successful exact-run request artifact with outcome skipped because the open pull request does not carry the generated-artifact-refresh label
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The trusted dispatcher publishes canonical skipped evidence bound to the exact pull request and head SHA, requests no writer run, performs no repository mutation, and completes successfully.
steps: Download the exact run-bound request artifact and validate its contract, pull request number, expected head SHA, and source run ID.
Recognize the authenticated skipped outcome before dispatcher branch or pull-request revalidation, checkout, or writer dispatch.
Emit mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh-dispatch.v1 with outcome skipped and preserve the original request reason.
Load the trusted publisher from main, publish structured exact-head evidence, and complete successfully without invoking the writer.
assertions: A skipped request is not reclassified as blocked.
Malformed contracts, invalid identities, source-run mismatches, and explicit blocked requests remain fail-closed before skipped handling.
Skipped handling terminates before branch or PR revalidation and before writer dispatch.
The eligible labeled writer path remains unchanged and is the only path allowed to dispatch the governed writer.
The ubuntu-24.04 runner pin and queued delegated-run null encoding already present on main are preserved.
No workflow-dispatch POST, repository content write, protected-ref mutation, or force push occurs on the skipped path.
Structured evidence remains independent of job logs and declares secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: Observe one unlabeled ready-for-review pull request produce a skipped request artifact and a successful canonical dispatcher decision without a delegated writer run.
Continue rejecting invalid contracts, stale source runs, malformed identities, and explicit blocked requests while preserving only authenticated skipped requests.
The skipped-decision bridge performs no provider or deployment canary.
The skipped path performs no Production, deployment, provider, database, or protected-ref mutation.
